newsitem.title: USA: HealthSpan names Steven Cady CEO.
newsitem.headline: HealthSpan names Steven Cady CEO.

text.p: HealthSpan Inc said Tuesday it had appointed Steven Cady as chief executive officer, president and chairman of the company's board of directors.

HealthSpan said in a statement that Cady had worked as chairman and chief executive officer of Direct Sales Concepts Inc and president and chief executive officer of SSC Marketing Inc, among other companies.
The company did not say whom he would be replacing and officials were not immediately available for comment.
